name: Node Pipeline
tagline: Pure-black glowing node pipelines rendered from slides[].graph data, one colour per concept.
whenToUse: Spine C listicles ('N ways X is built'): an overview cover that grids every item's own diagram, then one proof pipeline per item in its own colour
Spine D system builds: system cover, then inspector slides whose rail grows step by step
Spine A explainers: system cover, explain / parts pipelines, compare, inspector slides with a real capture or an exact-text card

fonts.headline: Inter ExtraBold (Google) — titles 60px in the accent with glow; cover headline 84px white
fonts.body: Inter Medium / SemiBold — gloss 34px, captions 30px, node labels 30px
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono — tags, sub-labels, loop tags, panel bars, exact-text cards, footer (28px)

palette.ground: #000000 flat, one radial haze behind the branching section
palette.orange: #D9551F / glow #FF8A4C / deep #4A1D0B / badge #F5EBE0 (hero item; whole deck on spines A and D)
palette.grey: #8A8A8A rims / #2A2A2A fills, no glow — the compare slide's old way only
palette.banned: no purple, pink, teal or cyan anywhere

graph: slides[].graph — rows of nodes {label, kind step|decision|tool, icon, logo, state done|live|ghost, sub, color}; edges '1>2' (taken) / '1~2' (ghost) or [{from,to,kind}]; loop {from,to,tag}; the storyboard.json form (rows of ids + nodes[]) is accepted verbatim
fitPass: Auto-layout from the data; render() throws (export.mjs exits 1) on any overflow: copy caps, rows/nodes per layout, label wrap or collision, band overflow, loop tag, title/caption lines, exact-text card overflow. Type never shrinks.
icons: Lucide (ISC) glyphs inlined from shared/vendor/lucide/ in the ICONS map; aliases magnifier, chat, checklist, branch, merge, person, bolt, edit, test
realCaptureSlots: proof chip, compare chip, inspector panel and use zones are (export.mjs exits 2 if one fails to load)

files.slides.html: copy to the deck root, edit DECK + slides[] at the bottom
files.assets/: sample real captures (public Claude Code docs pages) + claude-white.png; copy to the deck's assets/
files.preview.png: look reference rendered from this file's sample slides (cover, proof pipeline, compare, inspector)
